title: One Open Memory Care Residency per Resident
content:
A resident holds at most 1 Memory Care Residency Agreement residency at a time.

## Rule

1. A new memory care admission may be opened only when the resident has no other memory care residency in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status. The test is made on the company's residency records for that resident, before the admission is opened; it is not answered by what a caller says about the resident's arrangements.
2. A memory care admission may coexist with an assisted living or independent living residency in active, on leave or notice given status only when the admission source of the memory care admission is a Larkspur assisted living residency or a Larkspur independent living residency, which marks a move from that Larkspur residence. The earlier residency then ends under its own agreement's terms.

## Status of an existing memory care residency and its effect on a new admission

| Status of the resident's other memory care residency | New memory care admission may be opened |
|---|---|
| Pending admission | No |
| Active | No |
| On leave | No |
| Notice given | No |
| Vacated, closed or cancelled | The one-residency limit does not stand in the way |

The last row follows from the list in clause 1, which names the four statuses that block a new admission; a residency in any other status is not one of them.

## Coexistence with another Larkspur residence

| Resident also holds an assisted living or independent living residency that is active, on leave or notice given | Admission source of the memory care admission | Coexistence permitted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | A Larkspur assisted living residency | Yes - the move is from that residence, which ends under its own terms |
| Yes | A Larkspur independent living residency | Yes - the move is from that residence, which ends under its own terms |
| Yes | Any other source | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Which records decide.** The resident's memory care residency records and their statuses decide clause 1; a resident whose earlier memory care file is closed is not holding an open residency.
- **The meaning of the admission source.** Recording a Larkspur assisted or independent living residency as the admission source states that the resident is moving from that residence into memory care; that is what allows the two to stand side by side until the earlier one ends.
